triggers.title: Lane/runtime reliability classification
triggers.fires_when: A lane, runner, runtime, dependency-install, or workflow-adjacent failure cannot be distinguished from product regression.
triggers.claim_effect: Do not widen runtime or proving claims until red results can distinguish infrastructure failure from product regression.

triggers.title: Baseline-relative breakage map generation
triggers.fires_when: A migration tranche changes behavior, artifacts, packets, or consumers and failure ownership still requires human synthesis.
triggers.claim_effect: Migration can continue only if changed surfaces, expected drift, regressions, owners, and next fix targets stay explicit.

triggers.title: Scheduled or manual heavier baseline suites
triggers.fires_when: Tier 0 or Tier 1 is green but the claim needs compiled-suite or baseline-relative proof.
triggers.claim_effect: Do not claim compiled-suite or broad baseline-relative non-regression from Fast Checks alone.
